name: citelog
description: Can ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini crawl, read and cite your site? AI search readiness checks.
long_description: Citelog shows what AI crawlers see on a page, runs ten readiness checks (robots.txt for AI crawlers, content without JavaScript, a quotable answer, JSON-LD, canonical, title, question headings, updated date, llms.txt), explains each fix, reads access logs for verified AI crawler visits, and, only when you confirm, asks the engines your questions on your own API keys. No account and no telemetry: it fetches only the sites you ask about.
